subject: lk-imp
title: LK.IMP.------TRS.
description: Diagram in CMOA(II)-5 (Creative Music Outside of America, Level One — France/Italy/Northern Europe/Japan), first of two on book p247. Accompanies Braxton's claim: 'the influence (and impact) of given touring ensembles should not be viewed in narrow terms, for the exposure and effect generated through live performance is directly related to how the composite music was perceived.' LK-IMP (linkage implications) is crossed with TRS (transition): the question is what linkage-implications produces when crossed with transition — under conditions where touring (the operational vehicle of transition) shapes European reception of American creative music. TRS sits at the upper-right. DY-FT (dynamic functionalism) rises from the main line and carries IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) on the upper-left. POL-DY (political dynamics) hangs below the main line and carries EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). MT-INFO (multi-information) branches from the main line to the right and carries DOC (documentation). A vertical from the main line runs down to INFO-DY (information dynamics); from it a diagonal runs to AF-DY (affinity dynamics), from which (R)INTR (reality of interpretation) hangs, with INT (intention) hanging from (R)INTR at the lower-center.
